Name: Craft and Build from Containers
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses items from chests and storage furniture when crafting items from the crafting page or building buildings from either the carpenter shop or the wizard tower.

The mod will take items from the player inventory first, and if there is not enough it will take the remaining from chests.

There is a toggle key (disabled by default) that you can set to require holding down for use.

Using the mod for either crafting or building can be turned off in the config.


[size=5][b]Notes:[/b][/size]

For compatibility, the mod limits its use to within [b]CarpenterMenu[/b] and [b]CraftingPage[/b] classes.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
